system.specialAbility:
You become Trained in Diplomacy and Insight, and you become Trained in a relevant Lore of your choice.

Example Lores include Hospitality Lore, Cooking Lore, Lore of a local settlement.
system.description: You kept a common room welcoming and settled disputes before they became broken furniture. Travelers paid for a place to rest, and often left you more stories than coin.
